description: Minimal permissions for the main window (PLAN.md §9). File and network access go through Rust commands, not JS plugins. The dialog plugin is used from JS only to ask/confirm (folders and files are picked in Rust, so the path guard only grants what the user chose); the opener only opens http(s)/mailto/tel links in the default browser. Webview zoom backs the zoom setting (Ctrl +/−); window destroy lets the close guard close the window after asking about unsaved work.
